messages:
Jordan Lee: Quick postmortem follow-up. We need to finalize: statuspage wording (keep short), RCA sharing tiers, and recurring-flap escalation rules. I added a tiny tracker: https://ourdocs.internal/incidents/INC-2026-310/tracker :memo:

incident-bot: Postmortem uploaded: https://ourdocs.internal/incidents/INC-2026-310/postmortem (owner: @Jordan Lee) :page_facing_up:

Anika Rao: For statuspage labels, propose two public labels only: 'Degraded performance' and 'Partial outage'. Use thresholds: errors >=1% for >5m => Partial outage. Otherwise Degraded. Keeps copy simple for customers.

Devon Price: Agreed. For RCA sharing: publish a short redacted customer summary within 72h by default. If incident has single-owner fix and low blast radius, aim for 48h. Full technical RCA available on request to enterprise customers within 10 business days.

Jordan Lee: Who signs off redactions? Current: Security + Legal + Incident Owner. Can we allow Security alone for internal-only logs?

Anika Rao: Keep tri-signoff for anything posted externally. For internal-only summaries, Security can sign off alone but must record an "exception_reason" in the tracker. I'll add that field.

Devon Price: Also recurring patterns: if same subsystem has >=3 incidents in 30d, auto-open a follow-up ticket and email impacted subscribers. I'll own the detection job (small cron). Example cron: `0 4 * * Mon /opt/bin/patterns --inc INC-2026-310 --window 30d`

legal-bot: Reminder: loop in Legal on redaction checklist before external publish. Tag: legal@redwood.com

Jordan Lee: Action recap: A1 statuspage copy 0 Anika finalizes; A2 redaction signoff process 0 Anika to add tracker field & exceptions; A3 recurring-pattern detection 0 Devon to implement. I'll follow up in 24h with updated tracker links. :white_check_mark:
